providerStatusSemantics.QUEUED: an intent is persisted; NOT delivery success
providerStatusSemantics.INTERNAL_SUCCESS: an internal action completed; NOT customer-facing SENT
providerStatusSemantics.SENT: only after a real positive provider-success response
providerStatusSemantics.FAILED: only after a real attempted provider call failed
providerStatusSemantics.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: ambiguous provider acceptance; MUST NOT be blindly retried; retains its frequency-cap slot until reconciliation
providerStatusSemantics.DISABLED: zero provider/network calls; records the exact disabled gate
providerStatusSemantics.NOT_CONFIGURED: zero provider/network calls; records missing configuration

frequencyCapInvariant.atomicity: the cap slot and the outbox intent are created in one transaction
